> Can you explain what this "check and possibly close popover stack" algorithm does in terms of user experience? Check and possibly close popover stack recalculates the popover stack being built from the relationships of the popovers to each other in the DOM and from the popover target attributes and reconciles it with the currently open popovers. hello world

hello world
``` There are additional test cases in the WPT. Does this help?
